title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on today's biggest Israeli sports stories, from a chess board in Dresden to a high jump pit in Birmingham.

questions.question: In which city did Israel's senior open team win its first-ever team medal at a Chess Olympiad?
questions.explanation: Israel took silver at the 38th Chess Olympiad, held in Dresden, Germany from 12–25 November 2008.

questions.question: Which Premier League club has reportedly agreed a fee of roughly £21m for Israel international Anan Khalaili?
questions.explanation: Crystal Palace beat out Everton, Aston Villa and Newcastle to sign Khalaili from Union Saint-Gilloise, making him the most expensive Israeli player in history.

questions.question: Ariel Berkovich, just promoted to Maccabi Ironi Ramat Gan's senior squad, is the grandson of which Israeli basketball legend?
questions.explanation: Ariel Berkovich is the grandson of Miki Berkovich, the Maccabi Tel Aviv and Israel great who won 16 Israeli titles and two European Champions Cups.

questions.question: What is Yonathan Kapitolnik's personal best in the high jump, set indoors in 2025?
questions.explanation: Kapitolnik, who qualified for the high jump final at the 2026 European Championships in Birmingham, holds an indoor personal best of 2.31m from 2025.

questions.question: Who scored the only goal as Hapoel Beer Sheva beat Crvena Zvezda 1-0 in the first leg of their European tie?
questions.explanation: Zahi Ahmed scored in the 38th minute in Szombathely, Hungary, giving Beer Sheva a slim lead ahead of the second leg in Belgrade.
